Mid-market B2B product search company. Primary contact: Head of Product (Priya Menon) and Eng lead (Marco Li). Wants to start on hosted API POC to validate reranking endpoint quality, then move to Dedicated for steady qps and predictable latency. Key ask: support for rerank endpoint that accepts candidate lists + signals, offline scoring for nightly re-rank pipeline, and ability to run batch scoring on dedicated nodes.

Summary from 2026-02-12 call: "We need visible regression metrics — if model tweak reduces MRR we can't ship it." Product team runs weekly A/B. Evaluating 250-500 qps during peak, cost sensitivity moderate: willing to commit for predictable pricing but needs RA/ARR guardrails. Latency target: p95 < 120ms for rerank step; end-to-end query (retrieval + rerank) target < 300ms.

Security: EU data residency for user signals; SOC2 required; SSO/SAML + audit logs + KMS. Also asked about offline scoring CLI and access to KV cache warmup across restarts. Interested in Redwood's quantization/variant suggestions to reduce unit cost while keeping fidelity.

Notes/quirks: product team prefers short, concrete eval tasks. They maintain curated eval sets (5k queries) — want guidance for rerank metric suite (MRR@10, NDCG@10, precision@k) and threshold-based alerts. They requested sample scoring harness and an estimate for Dedicated node sizing (A100 vs H100) for batch scoring of 200k candidate pairs nightly.
